title: Data Platform Engineer
content: <p>Larkspur Freight moves parcels across Europe. Our data platform team keeps the numbers honest.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Build batch and streaming pipelines in Python and SQL</li><li>Run Airflow and keep it healthy</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>3+ years of data engineering experience</li><li>Strong SQL and Python</li></ul><p>We are an equal opportunity employer &amp; value diversity.</p>
